description: This file defines the 'IMasterRaceService' interface for managing master race entities, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting master races asynchronously.

classes.name: IMasterRaceService
classes.description: An interface providing asynchronous operations for managing master race data, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all master races asynchronously, returning a read-only list of MasterRaceResponse objects.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a master race by its unique identifier, returning a MasterRaceResponse or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new master race using the provided request data, returning the created MasterRaceResponse and any validation problems encountered.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing master race identified by id with the provided request, returning the updated entity, a notFound flag, and validation problems.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a master race by id, returning true if successfully deleted or false if not found.
